import sys

p = [0] * 17
for i in range(1, 17):
    p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def solve(n, length):
    quotient = n // p[length]
    remainder = n % p[length]
    if remainder == 0:
        return quotient * length
    else:
        return quotient * length + min(solve(remainder, length - 1),
                                       length + solve(p[length] - remainder, length - 1))

def smain():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data)
    result = solve(n, 16)
    sys.stdout.write(str(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    smain()
